SELECT d.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_documents c WHERE c.parent_folder_id = d.id AND c.is_deleted = FALSE) AS child_count FROM knowledge_documents d WHERE d.is_deleted = FALSE
AND d.parent_folder_id = #{parentFolderId,jdbcType=BIGINT}
AND d.parent_folder_id IS NULL
ORDER BY CASE WHEN d.file_type = 'folder' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, d.updated_at DESC

WITH RECURSIVE folder_tree AS ( SELECT id FROM knowledge_documents WHERE is_deleted = FALSE
AND id = #{parentFolderId,jdbcType=BIGINT}
AND parent_folder_id IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT kd.id FROM knowledge_documents kd INNER JOIN folder_tree ft ON kd.parent_folder_id = ft.id WHERE kd.is_deleted = FALSE ) SELECT DISTINCT kd.* FROM knowledge_documents kd INNER JOIN folder_tree ft ON kd.parent_folder_id = ft.id OR kd.id = ft.id WHERE kd.file_type != 'folder' AND kd.is_deleted = FALSE AND kd.title ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%') ORDER BY kd.updated_at DESC

SELECT * FROM knowledge_documents WHERE is_deleted = FALSE AND ( file_type = 'folder' OR parent_folder_id IS NOT NULL OR (parent_folder_id IS NULL AND file_type != 'folder') ) ORDER BY COALESCE(parent_folder_id, 0), CASE WHEN file_type = 'folder' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, title
SELECT * FROM knowledge_documents WHERE file_hash = #{fileHash,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND is_deleted = FALSE LIMIT 1
